validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order" target="done"
                event:schema='{"type": "object", "properties": {"id": {"type": "strng"}}}'/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the inline schema of `<transition>` is not a valid JSON Schema: at `/properties/id/type`: value must be one of 'array', 'boolean', 'integer', 'null', 'number', 'object', 'string'
notes: a schema is checked against the metaschema of its dialect and compiled once, so every keyword has a valid value and every `pattern` is a valid regular expression
